independence: Does not import, call, edit or reproduce zapote-erc::pfc_switching. All numbers come from vendor device SPICE models run in ngspice.

solver.name: ngspice
solver.note: Batch mode (-b) for every run; every netlist and log retained under raw/netlists and raw/logs.

applied_operating_point.drain_off_state_v_note: off-state drain sits at bus + freewheel-diode forward drop
applied_operating_point.current_error_vs_requested_percent: turn-on +0.7..+1.4 %, turn-off -0.3..+0.2 %; measured event currents are reported per case rather than scaled.
applied_operating_point.external_gate_r_model: behavioral resistor R = 5.3 + 4.4*u(V(drive)-6); switches at V(drive)=6 V
applied_operating_point.inductor_note: sets di/dt = 400/180e-6 = 2.22 MA/s; the 180 uH campaign effective inductance

testbench.topology: 400 V bus -> 180 uH boost inductor -> switching node sw -> 0 V sense element -> MOSFET drain, MOSFET source to ground; freewheel SiC diode sw->bus (anode sw, cathode bus)
testbench.gate_network: PWL 0->12 V drive through behavioral external resistor (9.7 ohm on / 5.3 ohm off); vendor intrinsic gate network (Rg=0.82 ohm, Lg=5 nH) retained inside the model
testbench.turn_on_event: second pulse: diode is freewheeling, MOSFET turns on at ~12.0 A
testbench.turn_off_event: second pulse fall: MOSFET turns off at ~15.0 A
testbench.first_pulse_turn_off: also present on the waveform (at ~11.9 A) and is not used for the headline numbers
testbench.energy_integration: E = integral of v(drain)*i(Vsense) dt over a window spanning the switching transition; integrator = ngspice `meas tran ... integ <vector> from=.. to=..` on the vector pv = v(drain)*i(vsense)
testbench.integration_window_control: moving each window start 10 ns earlier changes Eon by 0.000 % and Eoff by +0.087 %
testbench.eoss_method: Coss(v) from a small-signal AC admittance sweep (100 kHz) at 25 DC drain-bias points, Vgs=0; Eoss(400) = integral of v*Coss(v) dv (trapezoidal). This is the datasheet Coss(v) definition. The direct DC-ramp method did not run (see failures).
testbench.eoss_grid_refinement: 43-point dense bias grid gives Eoss=9.762 uJ vs 9.758 uJ for the 25-point grid (0.04 %)
testbench.freewheel_diode: substitute Infineon IDH16G65C5_L3 (650 V / 16 A CoolSiC G5); retained part Wolfspeed C3D20065D (650 V / 20 A) not obtainable (see capture_log.txt)
